183: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

1207: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.
1463: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
1719: A murder victim is brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a beautiful woman, he exacts revenge on his killers – only to realize his enemy has discovered the one weakness that can destroy him forever.
Believe in the power of another.

Don't hunt what you can't kill.

They left for war as boys never to return as men.

Nameless, faceless... relentlessly moving towards the date with death that would rock the world.

How one man betrayed the security of a nation.

SPENCER TRACY in his most suspenseful role...ERNEST HEMINGWAY'S story of Heroism...Defeat...Victory!
4023: Two college roommates venture out to identify a fellow student, who is most likely to commit suicide as it will help them pass the semester.
Roommate Wanted... For a Limited Time Only.

The ultimate battle between Naughty and Nice.

All is fair in love and Rome.

Born 2 the life. True 2 the code. Bad 2 the bone.
5303: Framed and on the run, a former FBI agent must save his family from a blazing fire in the world's tallest building.

He's a talent agent. She's a thief. Looks like they've already got something in common.
5815: A financially strapped mother joins a Mohawk woman to smuggle illegal immigrants into the United States.

The FIRST Certified Crazy Person's Comedy.

Too much of a good thing is wonderful.

There's only one way these two are going to get along...

8887: No beau? No problem! To earn money for college, a high schooler creates a dating app that lets him act as a stand-in boyfriend.
He's whoever you want him to be.

A master director shining his light on the best rock band on the planet.
Self - The Rolling Stones Vocals, Guitar, Harmonica
Self - The Rolling Stones Guitar, Vocals
Self - The Rolling Stones Saxophone, Keyboards
9399: The love story of young Countess Natasha Rostova and Count Pierre Bezukhov is interwoven with the Great Patriotic War of 1812 against Napoleon's invading army.
The greatest novel ever written ... Now magnificently alive on the screen!
9655: Against all the odds, a thirteen year old boy in Malawi invents an unconventional way to save his family and village from famine.
9911: A recent high school graduate is faced with two options, either go to a business school where his father wants him to go to, or get a full time job. He's got 24 hours to convince the one girl he really loves that he's honest, faithful, and fully committed. It's going to be a long night.

ALIEN was the beginning… Hell Has Just Been Relocated!

Big Jim Brannigan takes on London - Chicago Style !

14263: A jazz singer and a British jewel thief are brought together by their mutual desire to forget the past.
le pharmacien et le docteur Lamy

Never underestimate the power of a woman.

A chase where only the strongest survive.

An out of the ordinary weekend in the life of an Argentine family

Col. Douglas Campbell, Chief of HADES

John Ford's lusty successor to "Fort Apache" and "She Wore a Yellow Ribbon"

When destruction rises, can life prevail?
19895: Five Norwegians head for a cabin in the wilderness for a few days of teambuilding. But strange things start happening — especially down by the water where they find an abandoned tent. Is there someone else?
They should have stayed away from that water

Redemption is a journey you can't take alone.

You've got to die a few times before you can live.

Some doors should never be opened.

Remember your humanity and forget the rest.

Did you think it would stay sweet forever? Then why is it so sour?

Makes room for your broadest grins and your longest laughs!

Monte Walsh is what the West was all about.
30391: Rudran, a fearless cop who battles against drug mafia, gets trapped in a PCR (Protection of Civil Rights) case, unfortunately. Will he prove himself innocent?

30903: The story follows a team of highly trained operatives who find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound.
31159: A disguised professional assassin with a mysterious past is tasked with assassinating a top government official.

READY! SET! LAUGH! Join the fun in a nut-house of terror!

Explore true love and affections from the angle of ordinary people.

You can never escape your past

You may have forgotten your past, but it hasn't forgotten you…
32439: A dwarf and a transvestite, both are excluded from the society and doomed to exist at night. Their lives overlap in a strange encounter and this becomes the start of their friendship.
32695: Erika is mentally bruised and starts group therapy with people seeking absolute anonymity.
32951: After the assault of a young woman in their seaside town, a security expert and his family get caught in a powerful riptide of secrets and lies.
33207: On a trip home to visit her father, Jenny is thrown into a world of mystery, horror and legend when she is called upon by 3000 year old spirits of the Neverlake to help return their lost artifacts and save the lives of missing children.
Horror is Nothing More Than Truth
